concept: Sell it as a spell-action game. There is no intro: frame 0 is a lightning strike frozen on a hit-stop together with the hook's impact, then the hits come faster and faster (the cheer fireball bursting into hearts with 하트 명중! on beat 4, a spell bouncing off a focus barrier on beat 6, a coffee splash on beat 7), a half-beat of silence, and the logo slams on a drum-less sting at 3.7 s. The build is quick: the whole office of wizards (모두가 마법사!), a warp-in and a blink-out, the spellbook UI (마법을 골라라!) paying off in that very cast's fireworks, and a wand charge into the half-beat gap. The first drop (13.1 s) plays the arsenal in a strict grammar: wand up on beat four, spell on the bar, hit-stop and shake on every impact. Only three HUD tags name things (칭찬 번개, 커피 메테오, 결계 · 집중 모드), and the drop ends on the barrier bounce. The familiar breakdown is a tight four bars: the hatch with 사역마 탄생! on the pop, a pat, a snack, the summoning circle when my own Claude's reply arrives, and the quest stamp with 퀘스트 완료!. Then the drums come back under the familiar's little spells cut 2-2-1-1, and the town comes and goes up the riser (a paper plane, a work-log rune, a blink-out, a warp-in). The final drop opens on a white-flash high-five combo and rips through close-ups (zap, coffee, a second combo, fireworks, a '!' call) for five bars of full groove before its riser. Under that riser the party circle draws itself (파티 결성!), and a stutter zoom on the wand (medium, close, then extreme at 0.5x) holds its charge in the silence. The climax is the group cheer: coffee, potion and fireball hit one wizard, then the golden pillar holds for three beats before a white flash to the end card and the tagline. There is no caption band, no explainer card and no number. On-screen text is only short Korean shouts timed on each shot's peak and HUD tags at the cut, and the game's own floating words (화르륵!, 찌릿!, 튕!, 카페인 충전!, 회복!, 콤보!, 전설의 응원!) are never repeated as callouts. Engine mapping (music.ts sectionKind): hook is a drop with an impact on frame 0; title sting is a sting (a hit and a ringing chord with no beat, after a riser and a gap); then build, drop, break, groove and final; climax is a second final; outro is the end card. Every drop, the sting, the climax and the end card start after a riser and a half-beat gap. At 128.57 BPM a beat is 14 frames, so the trailer runs 61.6 s with 44 shots. Takes: no take is shown twice. The fireball is used only once, because its second take is the raid's own hit. The hook's one-beat coffee flash is the raid's splash, kept as a deliberate flash-forward. Footage note: the only digits left on screen are product UI, namely the meeting chip under the party circle and the pet room's unread dot after the reply. Hide the dot in the pet capture's CSS if wanted.

sections.name: hook
sections.mood: cold open at full tilt (a drop): impact on the very first frame, four-on-the-floor kick with sidechain pump, claps on two and four, the square-lead hook over D A Bm G, a noise riser climbing under both bars and a half-beat of silence before the logo

sections.name: title sting
sections.mood: logo sting: one big sub boom and crash, a bright D major chord ringing out with a quick run up on top, no beat

sections.name: build
sections.mood: build: kick on one and three, then on every beat, off-beat hats, the octave pulse bass and pads opening up, bright arps; a snare roll and a riser through the last two bars into a half-beat of silence

sections.name: drop
sections.mood: first drop, the spell arsenal: impact on the downbeat, full kick with sidechain pump, clap backbeat, the square-lead hook, a snare fill closing the fourth bar; every wand charge on beat four, every spell landing on a beat with its own hit

sections.name: break
sections.mood: familiar breakdown: drums fall away, soft triangle bass, warm pads, twinkly arps and a quiet triangle echo of the hook; one extra hit on the hatch, a light snare build in the last bar

sections.name: groove
sections.mood: groove: kick and claps come back on a crash under the familiar's little spells, octave pulse bass and bright arps; a riser over the last two bars into a half-beat of silence

sections.name: final
sections.mood: last act at full power: impact on the downbeat, crashes every other bar, the lead doubled an octave up, a hit under every spell; a riser over the last two bars and a half-beat of silence for the slow-motion wand charge

sections.name: climax
sections.mood: the group cheer: impact on the downbeat, everything at full, an extra hit under the golden pillar, then a riser into a half-beat of silence before the logo

sections.name: outro
sections.mood: logo end card: a last impact and a ringing D major chord with a sparkling arpeggio run, fading out
